The veterinary doctors and medical staff who cared for my puppy were wonderful—attentive, gentle, and took great care of him. However, the checkout experience with the receptionist could use some improvement in customer service. When handing me my change, the staff member dropped the money into my hand so carelessly that it fell to the floor, leaving me with the uncomfortable impression that he was trying to avoid making hand contact entirely. While he did apologize when he saw my reaction, a little more basic courtesy and respect at the front counter would go a long way. I really appreciate the medical team, but customer service matters just as much.
